notes: Every entry is a bound command: absolute interpreter, absolute cwd, argv array (never a shell string), explicit timeout, explicit raw+expected returncode.
--basetemp always points inside this attempt (a freshly created empty directory).
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 keeps __pycache__ out of the copied trees; PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 keeps evidence readable.
The RED commands (c1/c2) ran against before/baseline_tree/rf (pre-edit code). Everything from c3 on ran against iso/rf (edited code).

All TWELVE verification commands in this file were executed after the edit (eight pytest/validation commands plus the two RED commands, the census and the diff generator; c15/c16 were added in the round-1 revision and c22 is a packaging check whose raw output is in after/) and every raw return code matched its frozen expectation (0/0).
TEST VALUES ARE NOT NORMATIVE: 20 s (T), 65536 B (L) and 3600 s (W) appear only in tests/bindings and are injected explicitly. OPEN-D7 is not adjudicated.

A previous revision of handoff.json said 'eight bound commands'; commands.json has 15 bound entries (the original 12 plus c15, c16 and the round-2 contract command). The count was wrong in the handoff text, not in this file.

ROUND 2: the attestation commitment is now CONSUMED on a real artifact. verify_publication_attestation compares record['payload_sha256'] against payload_sha256(result) AND against the artifact's own exported statement; run_forecast exports result['payload_sha256'] for signed publications; the key is excluded from the projection (a self-referential key would make the commitment depend on itself). Test: tests/test_publication_attestation_contract.py.

ROUND 4 (R3-6): every command that can run product code against iso/rf now declares <attempt>/iso/rf/artifacts/ as a write root. The pytest commands redirect REVENUE_PUBLICATION_REGISTRY under --basetemp, but a DIRECT run_forecast call (as in the contract tests) writes the isolated copy's own artifacts/registry/publications.jsonl, which is a RUNTIME ARTEFACT and is listed as such in after/product_hashes.txt section 2 -- never as a deliverable.
